summary: Sasol Limited furnished a routine Form 6-K with four exhibits, the visible content consisting of image attachments and no substantive special-situation disclosure. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or strategic action is stated. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as the equivalent of a US current report; the filing appears administrative in nature. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Because no deal mechanics, ownership change, or regulatory clock are described, there is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
